title: Q-STD-OPENFEATURE: serve the goal knobs through an OpenFeature provider
body:
**Owner:** platform-engineer
**Trigger:** standards register entry openfeature is planned (STANDARDS-1)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --probe openfeature
**Prediction:** standards_supported_share >= 0.8 within 336 h
**Status:** open

The goals loop turns bounded knobs (`seed/autonomy/goals.json`, `seed/worker/src/goals.js`) and tenants read them from `GET /api/goals/knobs?tenant=<id>`. Serve the same values through the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP) shape on the tick Worker so any OpenFeature SDK reads a knob as a flag, add a test that evaluates one knob through the OFREP route, then mark the register entry `supported` with `how` and `tests`.

**Out of scope:** a third-party flag vendor, a new knob, or any change to how the goals loop decides.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --probe openfeature
